policy.purpose: Optional ExtensionTower authentication and listing-package retrieval. User-directed reading, autofill and export of developer-console listing content, optional statistics and support messages. No integrated analytics or tracking service.
policy.sharedWith: Google and Microsoft operate their developer consoles using your existing session. Image extraction contacts the console image hosts. If connected, ExtensionTower receives the API key in authenticated requests and serves your extension list, packages and images.
policy.additional: The extension reads and fills supported Chrome Web Store and Edge Partner Center forms. It does not save drafts, submit items, tick certifications or change visibility or pricing. Local listing packages, settings and bounded run history are stored in browser IndexedDB on the relevant origin. Extract preferences are also stored in console-origin localStorage. Imported images and content stay in browser storage until replaced or cleared. The optional API key is stored in extension-origin IndexedDB and used only by the background worker; it is never passed to the developer-console page. ExtensionTower requests use credentials: omit. The extension caches a slim extension list, store item links, publisher IDs and pending operations locally. Optional Chrome exports may include console statistics and personal support messages with sender details; they are downloaded to the user’s computer, not sent to ExtensionTower by this extension. The Chrome console capture script reads console responses locally to support extraction. Extraction fetches console image URLs without cookies. Clearing the relevant browser site data and extension data removes local records; uninstalling does not necessarily clear developer-console origin data. The store account and any ExtensionTower account data have their respective providers’ retention policies. There is no sale of data or integrated advertising, analytics or tracking SDK. For access, deletion or privacy questions contact verbalike@gmail.com. Policy prepared from source version 0.6.0 on 2 November 2026; behavior has not been run or manually verified in this task.
